messages.recipient_title: Vice President - Sustainability and Innovation Centre
messages.subject: Executive Value Creation Brief | DEWA | Sustainability & Innovation
messages.body:
Dear Dr. Alnuaimi,

I am sharing a strategic value creation brief prepared for DEWA, focused on clean-energy innovation, sustainability reporting, public-sector partnerships, skills development and measurable climate performance. My current work spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and cross-functional execution in a multinational mining environment.

The attached brief outlines areas where this experience could support institutional alignment and sustainability delivery. I would welcome a short discussion regarding senior leadership or strategic mandates where my background would add value.

Regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop

strategic_brief.title: Strategic Value Creation Brief for DEWA
strategic_brief.prepared_for_title: Vice President - Sustainability and Innovation Centre
strategic_brief.executive_summary: Ragunauth Ramsaroop offers a leadership profile aligned with DEWA's agenda across clean-energy innovation, sustainability governance, public-sector partnerships, skills development and measurable climate performance. His experience combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships, social performance and executive advisory in a multinational mining environment. He works across operations, legal, finance, procurement, HR, security and technical teams, translating external obligations into coordinated execution. For DEWA, his strongest contribution would sit where innovation programmes, sustainability commitments, institutional relationships and operating delivery need common governance, evidence and executive accountability across stakeholders and implementation partners.
strategic_brief.company_context: DEWA continues to position sustainability and innovation as core elements of Dubai's energy and water transformation. Its 2026 disclosures include formal sustainability reporting, clean-technology programmes and initiatives connecting innovation, youth capability and public engagement. The Sustainability and Innovation Centre therefore sits at an important intersection between technology, policy, education, stakeholder partnerships and measurable environmental outcomes. As programmes scale, consistent governance and evidence become increasingly important for demonstrating impact and connecting innovation activity to enterprise priorities. Leadership that links government relations, ESG, partnership management and cross-functional implementation can help strengthen institutional confidence and convert strategic ambitions into repeatable operating outcomes.

opportunities.title: Innovation impact governance
opportunities.rationale: Clean-technology programmes create greater strategic value when pilots, partnerships, learning outcomes and environmental benefits are measured consistently and connected to enterprise priorities and decision-making.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I can establish impact frameworks, ownership matrices and executive dashboards linking innovation initiatives to measurable outcomes, evidence sources, partners and strategic objectives.

opportunities.title: Public-sector partnership architecture
opportunities.rationale: Sustainability and innovation programmes depend on collaboration with government entities, universities, technology partners and communities. Structured engagement improves continuity, accountability and alignment around shared outcomes.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I can build stakeholder maps, partnership governance and engagement calendars that connect institutional expectations to clear internal owners, milestones, decisions and evidence.

opportunities.title: Sustainability assurance discipline
opportunities.rationale: Formal sustainability reporting gains credibility when operational data, programme evidence and governance are traceable from source owners through review and executive approval processes.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I can support evidence registers, review gates and cross-functional assurance routines that make sustainability performance easier to validate, explain and scale across initiatives.

days_0_30: Map priority innovation programmes, stakeholders, evidence sources and strategic objectives.
days_31_60: Create impact measures, partnership registers and assurance routines.
days_61_90: Launch cross-functional governance for selected sustainability and innovation workstreams.
days_91_180: Embed executive reporting, lessons learned and scalable partnership practices.

potential_impact: Clearer measurement of innovation and sustainability outcomes.
Stronger governance of public-sector and technology partnerships.
More traceable evidence supporting sustainability reporting.
background_relevance: Government and regulatory relations across multiple public authorities.
ESG, strategic partnerships and social-performance leadership.
Cross-functional coordination with technical, operations, procurement, finance and executive teams.
